title: Thai Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired stir fry made with marinated chicken, crunchy vegetables, and savory sauce.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and carrots, and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add the Thai chili sauce and stir to combine.
Add the green beans and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
